no-restricted-globals.name: process
no-restricted-globals.message: Code that runs inside Claude Code has no process. Read the environment with mod.claude.env.

no-restricted-globals.name: Bun
no-restricted-globals.message: Code that runs inside Claude Code has no Bun. Run a program with mod.process.run.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Fetch through mod.http.fetch, so the test kit and the mod's permissions see the call.

no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: Wait with mod.claude.clock.after, so the test kit's clock drives it.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Repeat with mod.every, so the test kit's clock drives it.

no-restricted-properties.message: Read the time with mod.claude.clock.now, so the test kit's clock drives it.
